description: Header file defining structures, constants, and function prototypes for device adapter in a TR-069 management system, including licensing info, class-like structures, and external references.

classes.name: dm_amx_env_t_
classes.description: Structure representing environment info for AMX connection, including bus context, prefix, aliasing, and ACL rules.

classes.name: dm_app_data_t
classes.description: Structure holding application-specific data, such as vendor prefix.

classes.name: dm_deviceadapter_t_
classes.description: Main structure representing the device adapter, containing ACS and system connection environments and app data.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_GetACSInfo
methods.description: Returns pointer to the ACS environment info.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_GetSystemInfo
methods.description: Returns pointer to the system environment info.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_GetDataInfo
methods.description: Returns pointer to the device data info.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_GetConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration value for a given system parameter.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_GPV
methods.description: Gets multiple parameter values given an array of parameter names.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_GPN
methods.description: Gets parameter names from a specified path, optionally next level.
